slate-dark.$description: Slate Dark — Primary text, headings, footer background, hairline borders — near-black with a hint of warmth, never pure black

ivory-medium.$description: Ivory Medium — Page canvas and large surface fills — the parchment background that sets the entire warm tone

ivory-light.$description: Ivory Light — Card surfaces, elevated panels, skip-link buttons — one step brighter than canvas for subtle layering without shadows

cloud-medium.$description: Cloud Medium — Muted helper text, inactive nav items, secondary labels — the neutral that recedes without disappearing

cloud-dark.$description: Cloud Dark — Outlined button borders, mid-contrast dividers

stone.$description: Stone — Hairline borders and dividers between sections — visible but never assertive

slate-medium.$description: Slate Medium — Dark-on-dark borders inside the footer

oat-warm.$description: Oat Warm — Secondary warm surface for grouped panels and feature containers — a deeper paper tone for variety

manilla.$description: Manilla — Featured hero card background — vintage paper tone that signals editorial importance without color shouting

clay.$description: Clay — Filled CTA buttons (e.g. cookie consent accept) — the single chromatic accent in the system, a terracotta warmth that belongs to the earth-tone family rather than typical UI blue

clay-deep.$description: Clay Deep — Hover/pressed state for Clay CTAs and the canonical accent token — deeper version of the primary accent

anthropic-serif.$description: Editorial voice — used for the display heading at 68px, all body copy at 20px, card titles, and supporting paragraphs. The serif carries personality; its presence in body text (unusual for tech sites) signals research-publication DNA. Weight 400 is default, 600 for emphasis.

anthropic-sans.$description: UI chrome and display sans — nav links, buttons, footers, badges, and the bold sans display heading at 61px weight 700. The 61px sans display sits beside the 68px serif display as a deliberate dual-system: sans shouts declarative statements, serif reads as editorial essay.

anthropic-mono.$description: Reserved for code or technical snippets — appears sparingly
